headline: Copper Prices Fall as AI Sector Selloff Weighs on Metal Demand
summary: Copper futures extended declines, driven lower by global technology stock weakness and uncertainty surrounding artificial intelligence capital expenditure.
why: Copper is an essential industrial commodity used in electrical infrastructure, power grids, and data center buildouts.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Concerns over tech sector capital spending reductions dampened global copper demand expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Selling in AI-related tech stocks led investors to reassess industrial demand growth for copper in data centers.
